I wrote `neuron_growth_anthropic-claude-opus-5-5_01.html` (about 16 KB). I haven't opened it in a browser, so the look, the frame rate and the controls haven't been checked.

What the file sets up:
- **Page and library:** an 800×800 canvas centred on a `#05070f` background. dat.gui 0.7.9 is the only external script, loaded from cdnjs; everything else is inline HTML, CSS and plain JavaScript.
- **Code layout:** the script is split into commented sections for setup, GUI setup, neuron growth, synapse detection, pulse animation and rendering. The animation runs on `requestAnimationFrame`.
- **Growth:** 3–6 seed neurons start near the centre and grow branches step by step along smooth curves. Branches vary slightly in thickness and sometimes sprout side branches. Branch depth and total branch count are capped, and growth stops once the network reaches a stable size.
- **Synapses:** a synapse forms when two branch tips come within the distance threshold. Pairs that are already connected are skipped, so there are no duplicates. Synapses glow brighter than branches and pulse softly.
- **Pulses:** sparks move smoothly along existing connections, choosing different paths at random, and keep running after growth has stopped.
- **Visuals:** the glow and bloom use `shadowBlur` only, in your exact palette. There is a background glow, a faint vignette, light scanlines and a little animated noise. No images or textures are used.
- **GUI:** Growth, Synapses, Pulses and Visuals folders hold all 16 controls you listed, plus Regenerate, Clear and Pause/Resume buttons.

To try it, open the file in any modern browser. It needs internet access the first time to load dat.gui.

Create a single self-contained HTML file using HTML, CSS, vanilla JavaScript, and dat.gui.

Requirements:
- Use one 800×800 <canvas> centered on a dark background.
- Allowed external library: dat.gui for parameter controls.
- No other external libraries, frameworks, modules, or assets.
- Everything must be inside a single HTML file.

Color style:
- Use this exact neon palette:
  - Background: #05070f
  - Background glow: #101a3a
  - Main branch color: #00e5ff
  - Secondary branch accent: #d6ff00
  - Synapse color: #ff2bd6
  - Pulse color: #fff36a
  - UI/accent color: #ffd400
  - Optional dark grid/scanline color: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.08)
- The final look should be futuristic, high contrast, glowing, and slightly gritty.
- Use canvas shadowBlur for neon glow effects.
- Do not use images or textures.
- Do not mention any game, movie, brand, or copyrighted visual style in the generated code or comments.

GUI:
- Add a dat.gui control panel.
- Organize controls into folders:
  - Growth
  - Synapses
  - Pulses
  - Visuals
- Include controls for:
  - neuron count
  - branch growth speed
  - max branch depth
  - branch split chance
  - branch curvature
  - max branch length
  - synapse distance threshold
  - synapse glow strength
  - pulse speed
  - pulse frequency
  - pulse brightness
  - background color
  - branch color
  - accent branch color
  - synapse color
  - pulse color
- Add buttons:
  - regenerate network
  - clear canvas
  - pause/resume animation

- Generate 3–6 random seed neurons near the center.
- Each neuron recursively grows branching axon/dendrite lines.
- Growth should be animated step-by-step, not instant.
- Branches move in slightly random directions with smooth organic curves.
- Use quadratic curves or lightweight smoothing for organic shapes.
- Randomly vary branch thickness slightly.

{"path":"neuron_growth_anthropic-claude-opus-5-5_01.html","edit_description":"Create a single self-contained HTML file: neon neuron growth simulation. Only external: dat.gui via CDN <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/dat-gui/0.7.9/dat.gui.min.js">. Body background #05070f, flex-centered 800x800 canvas with subtle border/box-shadow in #ffd400-ish accent; style dat.gui accent #ffd400. No mention of any game/movie/brand.

Palette: bg #05070f, bg glow #101a3a, branch #00e5ff, accent branch #d6ff00, synapse #ff2bd6, pulse #fff36a, UI #ffd400, scanline rgba(0,229,255,0.08).

Params object: neuronCount 4 (3-6 step1), growthSpeed 1.5 (0.2-5), maxDepth 5 (1-8), splitChance 0.04 (0-0.2), curvature 0.25 (0-1), maxLength 90 (20-200), synapseDist 14 (4-40), synapseGlow 20 (0-50), pulseSpeed 0.02 (0.002-0.08), pulseFreq 0.08 (0-0.5, chance per frame to spawn), pulseBrightness 1 (0.2-2), bgColor, branchColor, accentColor, synapseColor, pulseColor, plus functions regenerate(), clear(), togglePause(). GUI folders Growth, Synapses, Pulses, Visuals (colors via addColor), buttons at root.

Sections with short comments: SETUP, GUI SETUP, NEURON GROWTH, SYNAPSE DETECTION, PULSE ANIMATION, RENDERING, MAIN LOOP.

Data: neurons [{x,y,id}], branches [{neuron, pts:[{x,y}], angle, depth, width, len, maxLen, growing, accent(bool), parent, parentIdx}], synapses [{a,b (branch indices), x,y, phase}], synapseKeys Set of "min-max" branch index keys, pulses [{path: array of points, t, speed}]. MAX_BRANCHES = 400.

Growth: seeds 3-6 (params.neuronCount) near center (radius 60). Each seed spawns 3-5 root branches at spread angles, depth 0. Each frame, for growing branches: accumulate len by growthSpeed; angle += (rand-0.5)*curvature*0.6 ; add new point every ~4px step. Width = random 0.8-2 decreasing with depth. When len >= maxLen*(0.6+0.4rand)/(1+depth*0.3) scaled by maxLength, stop and if depth<maxDepth spawn 2 children (with fork angle ±0.4-0.8). While growing, with splitChance spawn a side branch (depth+1, shorter, accent=true often). Stop if outside canvas margin. Respect MAX_BRANCHES. growthDone when no growing branches.

Synapse detection: for each growing branch tip, check other branches' tips of different neuron (or any not parent/child) within synapseDist; key dedupe; create synapse at midpoint; optionally stop both growing. Use tips of all branches (last point) — O(n^2) over ≤400 fine but only check growing tips vs all tips.

Pulses: spawn with probability pulseFreq per frame (and more when growth done), pick random synapse; build path: branch a points reversed from root... simpler: path = branch a points (root->tip) then synapse point then branch b points reversed (tip->root). Optionally extend to parent branch chain: prepend parent's points up to parentIdx by walking parents, so pulses travel from soma through synapse to other soma. Pulse t 0..1 advances by pulseSpeed*growthscale normalized by path length (speed px = pulseSpeed*400 per frame / pathLength). Interpolate position along polyline using cumulative lengths. Draw spark: bright head circle with shadowBlur, short trail of a few previous positions sampled back along path, a few random jitter short lines for electric feel. Also light up the synapse when pulse passes (set synapse.flash=1 decaying).

Rendering: fill bg color, radial gradient glow #101a3a at center; faint grid lines every 40px with scanline color; branches drawn as quadratic curves through midpoints (smooth), lineWidth width, strokeStyle branch or accent color, shadowBlur 8 shadowColor same, globalAlpha 0.85. Draw somas as glowing circles. Synapses: pulsating radius with sin(time+phase), shadowBlur synapseGlow*(1+flash), color synapse, plus small white core; brighter than branches. Pulses with globalCompositeOperation 'lighter'. Then scanlines every 3px with rgba(0,0,0,0.25) alpha plus animated random noise: ~150 tiny random 1px rects per frame low alpha (gritty). Vignette radial gradient transparent center to rgba(0,0,0,0.75) edges. HUD text small in #ffd400 monospace corner: "NEURONS n  BRANCHES n  SYNAPSES n  STATUS GROWING/STABLE/PAUSED".

Buttons: regenerate resets and regrows; clear empties all arrays (canvas blank bg); pause toggles paused flag (loop keeps requestAnimationFrame but skips updates; still render). Changing neuronCount or maxDepth via onFinishChange regenerates. requestAnimationFrame loop."}
